svg.title: Compare each gap with the HSD
svg.desc: Three analytical methods have five measurements each, with means 10, 12 and 17 mg/L. With an HSD of approximately 3.4 mg/L, C differs from A and B. The A–B result is inconclusive.
svg.text: Three methods, five measurements per method. The overall ANOVA is significant.
Mean concentrations A: 10 B: 12 C: 17 mg/L
HSD stands for Honestly Significant Difference.
